svg.title: Fraud Shield — prediction workflow
svg.desc: End-to-end flowchart of the Fraud Shield prediction pipeline from transaction input through validation, behavior analysis, feature engineering, ML scoring, risk calculation, alert generation, and output.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does single-transaction monitoring work in Fraud Shield?')
sendPrompt('How does CSV batch upload fraud detection work in Fraud Shield?')
sendPrompt('What fields does parse_transaction() validate and what triggers a 400 error?')
g.text: scoring_service.parse_transaction() — required fields, amount, date and time format

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Fraud Shield load and store customer behavior profiles?')
sendPrompt('What behavior signals does Fraud Shield detect and how are behavior points accumulated?')
g.text: analyze_behavior() — new device, country, category, amount spike, velocity

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the 15 model features engineered by feature_engineering.py?')
sendPrompt('How does the StandardScaler transform features and why is it fitted only on training data?')
g.text: scaler.transform() using fitted scaler.pkl — zero mean, unit variance

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Random Forest classify a transaction and return a fraud probability?')
g.text: model.predict_proba() from fraud_model.pkl — 200 trees, balanced class weight

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How was the fraud probability threshold of 0.449 chosen and how is it applied?')
g.text: probability ≥ 0.449 → Fraud, else Normal — tuned on validation F2 score

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the risk score formula and what determines Low, Medium, High, and Critical levels?')
g.text: ML × 0.72 + prediction flag (+10) + behavior points (capped at 28)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What triggers an alert in Fraud Shield and what does the alert record contain?')
sendPrompt('How does Fraud Shield update the customer behavior profile after a transaction?')
sendPrompt('What is saved to instance/data_store.json after each transaction in Fraud Shield?')
g.text: save_state() → data_store.json — label, probability, risk, behavior, preprocessing
